main.description: Lists public acknowledgements by publisher or subject; authentication is not required.

authors.description: Publisher DIDs; OR within this filter.

subjects.description: Subject record AT-URIs; matching ignores CID.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for createdAt and URI; default desc.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor bound to sortDirection; keep other parameters unchanged.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter value, sort direction, page bound, cursor, repeated scalar, or query parameter is invalid.
